description: This source file defines an abstract class `AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter` in Scala, which implements the `DiagnosticLoggingAdapter` interface. The class is designed to facilitate logging with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) support and is intended to be used in Java implementations. It provides methods for managing MDC entries, including adding, removing, and discarding entries, and retrieving the logger's name.

classes.name: AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class implementing `DiagnosticLoggingAdapter`, providing MDC management functionalities for logging.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Associates a diagnostic context value with the specified key in MDC, returning an adapted logger.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes the MDC entry associated with the specified key.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries managed by this logger.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logger.
